==Notes==
*This skill creates a [[Spirit of Frozen Soil]].
*This spirit prevents creatures in its range from using resurrection skills, not resurrection itself.
**A creature outside the range of the spirit can resurrect a character inside its range, while a character inside its range cannot resurrect a character outside its range.
**[[Unyielding Aura]], [[Lively Was Naomei]] and [[Restoration]] will still resurrect when removed, dropped or destroyed respectively, but none of these can be cast while in range of this spirit.
**A [[Scroll of Resurrection]] will still work, as it is not a skill.
*Does not affect skills that resurrect [[pet]]s.
*Can be combined with [[Gaze of Fury]] or [[Rupture Soul]] to kill the spirit on command, expediting party resurrection.
{{bug|[[Eternal Aura]] can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.}}
